svg.title: Static gravity-field errors of gradiometer missions
svg.text: Static gravity-field errors of gradiometer missions
Geoid degree amplitudes, m: the GOCO06s signal against formal errors of a radial-gradient (V_zz) gradiometer, propagated in closed form
(uniform coverage, no polar gap, one tensor component). Compare Zingerle et al. (2024), Figs. 5 and 7, and Trimeche et al. (2019).
GOCE-like: 11 mE/√Hz (rising below 5 mHz), 255 km, 47 months
